goal: Prevent estimatesmartfee from returning bad or missing fee estimates after startup or a cold restart
Stops wallets from underpaying by falling back to block_policy estimates when mempool data is not ready
reviewability: Ready to review: mergeable, CI passing, author actively iterating with 7 force-pushes
A couple of open design questions remain but are not flagged as blocking
agreement: Strong support with concept ACKs and a full re-ACK on the latest revision (polespinasa, sedited, achow101, jeanpablojp, pseudoramdom)
Design concern about LOW_COVERAGE fallback addressed by a force-push confirmed fixed (willcl-ark)
Unaddressed clarifying questions about warmup persistence and block-count constant, not blocking (davidgumberg)
Real-world confirmation the underlying problem occurs in production (instagibbs)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes a real fee-underestimation bug confirmed in production affecting wallets and Lightning implementations
Benefit is felt by any software relying on Bitcoin Core fee estimates, not just direct users
Not a consensus or DoS issue so ranked below higher-severity policy work
